data.title: Greetings & Conversation — Starter · Lesson 3
data.subject: greetings
data.lyrics:
Hey, hey, it's time to party!

[Hook]
Hello… Hola
How's it going?… ¿Qué tal?
Friend… Amigo
Let's celebrate… ¡Vamos a celebrar!
Birthday time, let's go.

[Verse]
Buenas… Good vibes in the air
Saludo… A greeting everywhere
Amigo… Friend by my side
Saluda… Greets with a smile so wide
Escucha… Listens to the music play
Habla… Speaks in a cheerful way
Buenas… Good times all around
Adiós… Goodbye, but we'll be back around

[Hook]
Hello… Hola
How's it going?… ¿Qué tal?
Friend… Amigo
Let's celebrate… ¡Vamos a celebrar!
Birthday time, let's go.

[Verse]
Pregunta… Asks if I'm having fun
Responde… I say, "Yes, under the sun"
Buenos días… Good morning turned to night
But the party keeps shining bright
Escucha… Listens to the laughter and cheer
Habla… Speaks words we all want to hear
Buenas… Good vibes never fade
Adiós… Goodbye, but the memories won't fade

[Bridge]
In this moment, we're all together
Celebrating, come sunshine or stormy weather
With every "Hola" and "Adiós"
